critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/staff creates auth user via admin API before checking if profile update succeeds — if the profile PATCH returns 0 rows (e.g., trigger didn't create the row yet), you orphan an auth user. Consider rollback via admin delete user or ensure profile exists via UPSERT.

POS.jsx applyStock() mutates local react-query cache before server confirms — fine for optimistic UX but ensure it is reverted on error path (currently code invalidates on error, which refetches, so OK).

Offline queue: client_ref is generated per PayDialog open (crypto.randomUUID) — good idempotency. Confirm the RPC also enforces uniqueness server-side (DB unique constraint on client_ref) to defend against the double-tap race across tabs.
No tests directory in /app/tests — backend tests placed at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py as per pytest.ini rootdir.
